name: pixelbar-codex
description: An on-demand project status panel inspired by pixelbar for Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Show a concise project and Git status panel.
interface.longDescription: An on-demand terminal status panel inspired by Claude Code pixelbar. It reports the current project, Git state, diff totals, stash count, and latest commit without changing the working tree.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the Pixelbar for Codex status panel for this project.
